## Parental OpControl 0.15.0

- Chat: child messages are flush right in blue and parent messages flush left in green, in the kid window and the dashboard (dark and light).
- Dashboard: "Press Enter to send" is saved per parent account and works on every browser and phone.
- Remote view: leaving the page, closing the tab, losing the connection or a browser crash now ends the session; a 30-second viewer heartbeat and startup cleanup remove stale sessions, and a new View request always starts cleanly.
- Websites: new Review panel with server-side title, description, favicon, category lists, block reason, seven-day visits and lookups, known-purpose notes and safe Visit/Block/Allow actions.
- Blocked attempts: every blocked visit shows its reason; alerts are throttled per domain and device (1 to 24 hours, default 6); visits are de-duplicated to one per five minutes while raw DNS lookups are kept separately; infrastructure, update and remote-support domains are never shown or blocked by categories; DWAgent and other support agents are excluded from "most used".
- Updates: the updater image now updates itself together with the web image.
- English and es-MX strings for all new screens.
